count-label.description: Compact disclosure text without a current step. Include {total}.

current-label.description: Localized text for the current step.

done-label.description: Localized text for a completed step.

error-label.description: Localized text for a step that has an error.

label.description: Accessible name of the list. Use a localized description of the task.

orientation.description: Use vertical for a stacked list. Horizontal layout compacts below 22rem.

summary-label.description: Compact disclosure text. Place {current} and {total} in the local order.

upcoming-label.description: Localized text for an upcoming step.

--ki-corner-activity-mark.description: Round corners for rings and typing dots.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-layout-spacing-7xl.description: The 7xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-md.description: The md spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-sm.description: The sm spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xl.description: The xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xs.description: The xs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xxs.description: The xxs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-stepper-connector.description: Decorative connector from a step that is still incomplete.

--ki-stepper-connector-done.description: Decorative connector from a completed step.

--ki-stepper-current-bg.description: Fill of the current step marker.

--ki-stepper-current-border.description: Outline of the current step marker.

--ki-stepper-current-fg.description: Number ink on the current step marker.

--ki-stepper-done-bg.description: Fill of a completed step marker.

--ki-stepper-done-fg.description: Glyph ink on the completed step marker.

--ki-stepper-error-bg.description: Fill of the step error marker.

--ki-stepper-error-border.description: Outline of the step error marker.

--ki-stepper-error-fg.description: Glyph ink of the step error marker.

--ki-stepper-glyph-size.description: Size of the marker and disclosure glyphs.

--ki-stepper-label-bg.description: Default backing of a step label.

--ki-stepper-label-fg.description: Default ink of a step label.

--ki-stepper-stroke.description: Width of the marker outline and connector.

--ki-stepper-upcoming-bg.description: Fill of an upcoming step marker.

--ki-stepper-upcoming-border.description: Outline of an upcoming step marker.

--ki-stepper-upcoming-fg.description: Number and label ink of an upcoming step.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.
